{{Top|leg}}
A '''Weaponry Declaration disk''' was a required form for any personal weapons carried by an individual upon landing on [[Algara II]]. Each disk listed the weapons carried by an individual, and proof of weapon license was required or the weapon was confiscated. However, individuals also required a [[Native Weaponry License]] before being allowed to carry the weapons on Algara II.
